Dates.text: Ingenuity completes the first powered, controlled flight on another planet.
The helicopter completes its fourth flight, traveling farther and faster.
Flight 25 reaches a new distance and speed record for the mission.

Title: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter
Body-Text: A small technology demonstrator that made the first powered flight on another planet, proving that aerial exploration is possible in the thin Martian atmosphere.
ModelFacts: Designed for the thin Martian atmosphere
